description: Povodne v povodí Myjavy, stav k 18.09.2024 - Copernicus EMS is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.geocloud.gov.sk. Flooded areas in the Myjava river basin, the dataset does not contain data on the depth of the flood. The data are derived from Copernicus EMS satellite images taken on 18.09.2024 09:50. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Floods in the Myjava basin, status as at 18.09.2024 - Copernicus EMS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Povodne, Copernicus. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
